responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s readonly-assignment diagnostics on lowered GCC tree nodes. Borrowing the c-family readonly checks, it scans saved function trees, parameters, variable declarations, and constant declarations from Compile::Context for MODIFY_EXPR writes to TREE_READONLY or constant lvalues, classifies the destination form (member, variable, parameter, named return value, function, or generic location), emits the corresponding GCC error wording, and rewrites the invalid lhs to error_mark_node to suppress cascading backend issues.
same_name_distinction: Implements the readonly-write checking pass over lowered GCC trees, including the tree walkers, readonly_error message selection, and mutation of invalid MODIFY_EXPR lvalues to error_mark_node; unlike the header, it holds the actual backend-oriented analysis and diagnostics logic.
